paper_title: Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large   Language Models
caption: Average cosine similarity between generated training samples (K=32) for each relation category.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the mean interclass similarity across different relation categories, comparing three distinct scenarios. The X-axis, labeled "Relation Category," ranges from 0 to beyond 60 with uniform intervals of 10, indicating the categories being compared. The Y-axis, labeled "Mean Interclass Similarity," spans from 0.0 to 0.5 with increments of 0.1, measuring the degree of similarity. Three colored lines represent different conditions: blue for "w/o DPO obo," orange for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," and green for "DPO." Each line exhibits fluctuations across the relation categories, with notable peaks and troughs.

The blue line for "w/o DPO obo" starts near 0.086, peaks at approximately 0.5 around category 2, and then fluctuates, generally staying below 0.3, with some dips near 0.0 around categories 30 and 60. The orange line for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" begins near 0.158 and shows significant variability, with several peaks above 0.3, notably around categories 3, 11, 28, and 32. The green line for "DPO" starts at about 0.086 and remains relatively stable, mostly below 0.2, with some minor fluctuations.

Additionally, the graph includes three dashed lines representing the average similarity for each condition: blue dashed for "w/o DPO obo" at 0.107, orange dashed for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" at 0.158, and green dashed for "DPO" at 0.086. These averages provide a baseline to compare the fluctuations observed in the respective colored lines. Overall, the graph effectively visualizes the comparative mean interclass similarity across different relation categories and conditions.
